# A01-S03: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]
Nice to hear from you – and your wild projects, I think it sounds really exciting. These are definitely some thoughts we can use in MindFuture and The 18. global goals.

[████] We are working on many things right now. We are creating a new identity for the whole place, which used to be called InQvation, but will be called MindFuture. People Ventures is separated from InQvation, where they originate and have developed from. They are also on an exciting journey. [████] Community will have a big role in our new setup internally as well as externally, this will also further brand The 18. global goals.

I think we should have a Teams meeting in the near future, where we can talk ideas and projects. So fun with Lars who works with computers. If you had called him Morten instead, you would find an abundance here 😊 Also a cool idea with the chatbot who is leader in a party – it could probably handle that well with good training!

[████]
I’ll check my calendar and book a meeting with you.
